1.w: The wisest of women builds her house, and a foolish woman with her own hands tears it down.

2.w: The one walking in his uprightness [is] fearful of YHWH, and the one devious in his ways despises Him.

3.w: In the mouth of a fool [is] a branch of pride, and the lips of the wise ones guard them.

4.w: With no oxen, the trough [is] empty, and an abundance of produce [is] by the strength of an ox.

5.w: A witness of faithfulness does not lie, and a witness of deception breathes out lies.

6.w: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and there is none, and knowledge [is] easy to the discerning one.

7.w: Depart from in front of a man [who is] foolish, for you will not know there the lips of knowledge.

8.w: The wisdom of a prudent one [is] to understand his way, and the folly of fools [is] deceit.

9.w: Fools mock the guilt offering, and among the upright ones [is] favor.

10.w: The heart knows the bitterness of its own soul, and in its joy a stranger does not share.

11.w: The house of the wicked ones will be destroyed, and the tent of the upright ones will flourish.

12.w: There is a way right before the face of a man, and its end [is] the way of death.

13.w: Even in laughter a heart may be pained, and the end of joy [is] grief.

14.w: The one turning back in heart will be filled from his ways, and a good man, from himself.

15.w: The simple one affirms every word, and the prudent one considers his step.

16.w: A wise one fears and turns aside from evil, and a fool is transgressing and is confident.

17.w: One short of nostrils acts [with] foolishness, and a man of schemes is hated.

18.w: The simple ones inherit foolishness, and the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

19.w: The evil ones will bow before the face of of good ones, and wicked ones at the gates of the righteous one.

20.w: The poor one is hated even by his neighbor, and those loving the rich one [are] many.

21.w: The one despising his neighbor sins, and the one showing favor [to] the poor [is] blessed.

22.w: Do they not go astray [who] are planning evil? And loving devotion and truth [are] unto those planning good.

23.w: In all labor there is profit, and a word of the lips [is] only to poverty.

24.w: The crown of the wise [is] their wealth; the folly of fools [is] folly.

25.w: A witness of truth is delivering souls, and one who breathes out lies [is] deceitful.

26.w: In the fear of YHWH confidence [is] strong, and for his sons there is a refuge.

27.w: The fear of YHWH [is] a fountain of life, to turn aside from the snares of death.

28.w: In a multitude of people [is] the glory of a king, and in a lack of people [is] the ruin of a prince.

29.w: The one slow to anger [is] great in understanding, and the one short of temper lifts up folly.

30.w: A heart of healing [is] life to the body, and jealousy [is] rottenness to the bones.

31.w: The one oppressing the poor reproaches his Maker, and the one honoring Him shows favor [to] the needy.

32.w: By his evil a wicked one is thrust down, and a righteous one takes refuge in his death.

33.w: In the heart of a discerning one wisdom rests, and within fools she makes herself known.

34.w: Righteousness exalts a nation, and sin [is] a reproach of peoples.

35.w: The favor of a king [is] toward a wise servant, and his wrath is to one causing shame.
